plan.title: Asset PR to Split Award and PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects for the PR-created event.
Enable splitting one line across multiple awarded vendors.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.

args.goal: set the Technical Stage evaluation duration to 30 minutes in the Schedule Event screen and save the schedule

steps.note: Set the exact evaluation duration, which set_schedule cannot parameterize.
Invite two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: add one Required T&C clause to the event and save it, ending on the create screen

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause before publishing.
Publish the Technical + RFQ event.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's technical response and RFQ quote at 100.
Verify the first vendor submission was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's technical response and RFQ quote at 90.
Verify the second vendor submission was accepted.
Wait for bidding and evaluation windows to close before comparison and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both bids are complete.
Verify the lower-priced second vendor ranks first.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate six units to the lower-priced vendor.
Allocate the remaining four units to the other vendor.
Verify both vendors are selected and the split proposal total is 6×90 + 4×100.
Create the split award proposal.
Submit the award proposal.
Verify the award proposal was submitted.

args.remark: Approved for split award of the asset PR line.

steps.note: Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders.
Verify one PO line exists for each awarded vendor.
Navigate to the events list to verify the event's historical placement.
Open the History tab after the event lifecycle completes.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
